steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "f6f316308520cff744b8a02545a5dedb09b27dbc"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

steps.name: update-security-dependencies
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/dev/null; npm uninstall --save-dev --ignore-scripts size-limit @size-limit/preset-app; npm uninstall --ignore-scripts glob; npm install --save-dev --ignore-scripts 'glob@^13.0.6'; npm install --save-exact --ignore-scripts svelte@5.57.0; npm install --save-dev --save-exact --ignore-scripts @inlang/paraglide-js@2.25.0 @sveltejs/kit@2.70.3 vite@7.3.6; npm install --save-dev --ignore-scripts vitest@4.1.11 @vitest/ui@4.1.11 @vitest/coverage-v8@4.1.11 dependency-cruiser@17.4.3 rollup@4.63.1; npm update --ignore-scripts; cd ..; git diff --check; git diff --stat; git status --short

steps.name: security-audit
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm audit --json >/tmp/matrixhub-security-after.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open('/tmp/matrixhub-security-after.json'))
v=d.get('metadata',{}).get('vulnerabilities',{})
print('AFTER_AUDIT', json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True))
for name,item in sorted(d.get('vulnerabilities',{}).items()): print(json.dumps({'name':name,'severity':item.get('severity'),'isDirect':item.get('isDirect'),'range':item.get('range'),'fixAvailable':item.get('fixAvailable')}, sort_keys=True))
if v.get('total',0): sys.exit(2)
PY

steps.name: frontend-quality
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm run quality:frontend

steps.name: commit-and-push
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git diff --check; git add interface/package.json interface/package-lock.json; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Harden frontend dependencies'; git fetch origin develop; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "f6f316308520cff744b8a02545a5dedb09b27dbc"; git push origin HEAD:develop; echo NEW_DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
